comment: Fresh context-free translations from all 30 current schema-2 GGSG19 review rows; Proposition 1 explicitly retains equality under independent uniform tie breaking.

MallowsArbitraryPairJointLocationDPOfQSp.tex_statement: For every repeated-insertion size N, parameter 0 <= q <= 1, and tracked candidate pair, the materialized dense dynamic-program table agrees pointwise with the independently defined PMF-bind process and sums to one; its exact unit-cost real scalar-operation count is N^2 (N+1)^4 and is at most (N+1)^6.

assumption_mallows_nontrivial_winner_and.tex_statement: {n : ℕ} (q : ℝ) (W : Candidate n) = 0 < W.val \land 0 < q \land q < 1

assumption_nontrivial_k_approval_cutoffs.tex_statement: {n : ℕ} {Rule : Type*} [Fintype Rule] (K : Rule \to ℕ) = (\forall rule, 0 < K rule) \land (\forall rule, K rule < n + 2)

assumption_pairwise_approval_ternary_gap.tex_statement: {Signal : Type*} [Fintype Signal] [DecidableEq Signal] (law : PMF Signal) (hiScore loScore : Signal \to ℝ) (pUp pDown pZero : ℝ) = pDown \le pUp \land (\forall signal, hiScore signal - loScore signal = 1 \lor hiScore signal - loScore signal = 0 \lor hiScore signal - loScore signal = -1) \land EconCSLib.pmfProb law (fun signal => hiScore signal - loScore signal = 1) = pUp \land EconCSLib.pmfProb law (fun signal => hiScore signal - loScore signal = -1) = pDown \land EconCSLib.pmfProb law (fun signal => hiScore signal - loScore signal = 0) = pZero

assumption_randomized_mechanism_probabil.tex_statement: {Rule : Type*} [Fintype Rule] (weight : Rule \to ℝ) = (\forall rule, 0 \le weight rule) \land (\sum rule : Rule, weight rule) = 1

mallows_arbitrary_pair_joint_location_dp.tex_statement: For every repeated-insertion size N, parameter 0 <= q <= 1, and tracked candidate pair, the materialized dense dynamic-program table agrees pointwise with the independently defined PMF-bind process and sums to one; its exact unit-cost real scalar-operation count is N^2 (N+1)^4 and is at most (N+1)^6.

paper_definition_design_invariant_statem.tex_statement: \forall {\Omega : Type u_1} {Rule : Type u_2} {Outcome : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace \Omega] (\mu : Measure \Omega) (reasonable : Rule \to Prop) (outcome : Rule \to ℕ \to \Omega \to Outcome), paper_definition_design_invariant \mu reasonable outcome \iff \exists Ostar, \forall (\beta : Rule), reasonable \beta \to \forallᵐ (\omega : \Omega) ∂\mu, \forallᶠ (N : ℕ) in atTop, outcome \beta N \omega = Ostar

paper_definition_large_deviation_rate_st.tex_statement: \forall (A : ℕ \to ℝ) (r : ℝ), paper_definition_large_deviation_rate A r \iff (\forall (N : ℕ), 0 \le A N) \land Tendsto A atTop (nhds 0) \land 0 < r \land Tendsto (fun N => -(↑N)⁻¹ * log (A N)) atTop (nhds r)

paper_definition_rate_optimal_statement.tex_statement: \forall {Rule : Type u_1} (feasible : Set Rule) (rate : Rule \to ℝ) (\betastar : Rule), paper_definition_rate_optimal feasible rate \betastar \iff \betastar \in feasible \land \forall \beta \in feasible, rate \beta \le rate \betastar

source_corollary_lem_mallowsnorando.tex_statement: For a finite Mallows model with q < 1 and a target W candidate, any finite randomized family of nontrivial K-approval rules is weakly dominated by some static proper-prefix cutoff, and that cutoff is optimal among static cutoffs for the Mallows top-W K-approval outcome rate.

source_corollary_lem_mallowsnorando_zero.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} (center : Ranking n) (W : Candidate n), 0 < ↑W \to \forall (randomizedRate : WithTop ℝ), HasExtendedExponentialRate (zeroNoiseTopWApprovalError center W) ⊤ \land randomizedRate \le ⊤

source_mallows_arbitrary_pair_joint_loca.tex_statement: For every repeated-insertion size N, parameter 0 <= q <= 1, and tracked candidate pair, the materialized dense dynamic-program table agrees pointwise with the independently defined PMF-bind process and sums to one; its exact unit-cost real scalar-operation count is N^2 (N+1)^4 and is at most (N+1)^6.

source_mallows_repeated_insertion_probab.tex_statement: \forall {N : ℕ} (q : ℝ) (hDomain : assumption_mallows_repeated_insertion_parameter_domain q) (stage inserted : Fin N), ((mallowsInsertionPMF q ⋯ stage) inserted).toReal = if ↑inserted \le ↑stage then q ^ (↑stage - ↑inserted) / \sum r \in range (↑stage + 1), q ^ (↑stage - r) else 0

source_model_cumulative_scores_ranking_a.tex_statement: For every positive voter count N, each candidate's score is the average of the N per-voter scores. Tier correctness is equivalent to every cross-tier pair being strictly ordered by these averages, with equal averages resolved by the independent uniform tie ranking.

source_model_k_approval_score.tex_statement: For every finite candidate ranking, cutoff K, and candidate, the K-approval score is one exactly when the candidate's rank is below K, and is zero otherwise.

source_model_k_ranking_score.tex_statement: For every finite candidate ranking, cutoff K, positional score beta, and candidate, the K-ranking score is beta at the candidate's revealed rank when that rank is below K, and is zero otherwise.

source_model_reasonable_positional_scori.tex_statement: For every finite positional score vector beta, its adjacent-drop vector is reasonable if and only if beta is nonincreasing at every adjacent pair and has at least one strict adjacent drop.

source_proof_mallows_common_pivotal_pair.tex_statement: For every finite positive-parameter Mallows model, nonempty top-W target, and nontrivial K-approval cutoff, the overall top-W outcome rate equals the pairwise rate of the adjacent center-rank boundary pair (W,W+1).

source_proof_mallows_four_candidate_join.tex_statement: For q in the closed interval from zero to one and every pair of final positions ell,k among four positions, the repeated-insertion joint-location probability of reference items three and four is zero on the diagonal and otherwise equals q to exponent 5-ell-k when ell<k or 6-ell-k when k<ell, divided by (1+q+q^2)(1+q+q^2+q^3).

source_proposition1_thm_consistency_tier.tex_statement: For every finite ranking law and ordered family of target tiers, strict top-prefix probability separation of every higher-tier candidate from every lower-tier candidate at every proper cutoff holds if and only if every reasonable prefix-score rule is almost surely eventually correct under independent uniform tie breaking. Equality is handled by the reverse implication and is not excluded by a no-tie premise.

source_proposition2_thm_pairwiselearning.tex_statement: For a finite signal law and two score functions with nonnegative expected score gap, the pairwise scoring error probability either has exponential rate pairwiseScoringRate, or has exponential rate -log pZero for a positive zero-gap probability pZero, or is eventually zero.

source_proposition3_lem_pairwiselearning.tex_statement: For finite ternary approval score gaps taking values 1, 0, and -1 with probabilities pUp, pZero, and pDown and pDown <= pUp, the pairwise scoring error probability either has exponential rate approvalPairwiseRate pUp pDown or is eventually zero.

source_proposition4_thm_goal_learning_ex.tex_statement: \forall {Pair : Type u_1} {Candidate : Type u_2} {Signal : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype Pair] [inst_1 : Nonempty Pair] [DecidableEq Pair] [inst_3 : Fintype Signal] [inst_4 : DecidableEq Signal] (law : PMF Signal) (score : Candidate \to Signal \to ℝ) (hi lo : Pair \to Candidate) (hmean : \forall (pair : Pair), 0 \le pmfExp law fun signal => score (hi pair) signal - score (lo pair) signal) (aPos aNeg : Pair \to Signal) (hmassPos : \forall (pair : Pair), 0 < (law (aPos pair)).toReal) (hgapPos : \forall (pair : Pair), 0 < score (hi pair) (aPos pair) - score (lo pair) (aPos pair)) (hmassNeg : \forall (pair : Pair), 0 < (law (aNeg pair)).toReal) (hgapNeg : \forall (pair : Pair), score (hi pair) (aNeg pair) - score (lo pair) (aNeg pair) < 0), HasExponentialRate ((proposition4_relevant_pair_rate_certificate_from_stationary_tilted_modal_log_support_of_mean_nonneg_pos_neg_atoms law score hi lo hmean aPos aNeg hmassPos hgapPos hmassNeg hgapNeg).aggregateError fun x => 1) (finiteOutcomeLearningRate fun pair => finiteIidPairwiseScoreGapChernoffRate law score (hi pair) (lo pair))

source_proposition4_thm_goal_learning_fi.tex_statement: \forall {Pair : Type u_1} {Candidate : Type u_2} {Signal : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype Pair] [inst_1 : Nonempty Pair] [inst_2 : Fintype Candidate] [inst_3 : Fintype Signal] [inst_4 : DecidableEq Signal] (law : PMF Signal) (score : Candidate \to Signal \to ℝ) (hi lo : Pair \to Candidate), (\forall (pair : Pair), 0 \le pmfExp law fun signal => score (hi pair) signal - score (lo pair) signal) \to \forall {aPos aNeg : Pair \to Signal}, (\forall (pair : Pair), 0 < (law (aPos pair)).toReal) \to (\forall (pair : Pair), 0 < score (hi pair) (aPos pair) - score (lo pair) (aPos pair)) \to (\forall (pair : Pair), 0 < (law (aNeg pair)).toReal) \to (\forall (pair : Pair), score (hi pair) (aNeg pair) - score (lo pair) (aNeg pair) < 0) \to card Pair \le card Candidate ^ 2 \to \forall (n : ℕ), \sum pair, finiteScoreGapPairwiseErrorProb law score (hi pair) (lo pair) n \le ↑(card Candidate) ^ 2 * exp (-↑n * finiteOutcomeLearningRate fun pair => pairwiseScoringRate law (score (hi pair)) (score (lo pair)))

source_theorem1_lem_randomizebetterscori.tex_statement: \forall {Pair : Type u_1} {Rule : Type u_2} {Signal : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype Pair] [inst_1 : Nonempty Pair] [inst_2 : Fintype Rule] [inst_3 : Fintype Signal] [inst_4 : DecidableEq Signal] (law : PMF Signal) (weight : Rule \to ℝ) (gap : Pair \to Rule \to Signal \to ℝ) (staticGap : Pair \to Signal \to ℝ), (\forall (pair : Pair) (signal : Signal), staticGap pair signal = \sum rule, weight rule * gap pair rule signal) \to (\forall (rule : Rule), 0 \le weight rule) \to \sum rule, weight rule = 1 \to (\forall (pair : Pair), BddBelow (range fun z => finiteLogMGF law (staticGap pair) z)) \to (finiteOutcomeLearningRate fun pair => randomizedScoringMixtureRate law weight (gap pair)) \le finiteOutcomeLearningRate fun pair => finiteChernoffRate law (staticGap pair)

source_theorem2_lem_randomizenotbetterap.tex_statement: For any finite randomized K-approval rule with nonnegative weights summing to 1 and any candidate pair, there exists a static component rule whose extended approval pairwise rate weakly dominates the randomized rule pairwise rate.

source_theorem_lem_mallowsnotWK_countere.tex_statement: There exists a high-noise Mallows instance centered at the identity in the four-candidate setting such that the W-approval cutoff is not approval-rate optimal: some different cutoff has strictly larger finite outcome-learning rate.

source_theorem_lem_randomizebetterapprov.tex_statement: In the constructed four-candidate W-selection ranking law, strict top-prefix dominance holds for the relevant cross-tier pairs, and the 50/50 randomized approval rule has finite outcome-learning rate strictly larger than the best static K-approval cutoff among the finite static family.
